title: ChatGPT vs Claude LLMs
author: Moist_Signal_5080
selftext: I’ve been using Claude to code my HTML game for me, which has been pretty reliable this far. When I run out of usage for the day/week, sometimes I’ll switch to ChatGPT to try and get a few things done. Every single time it does something weird tho, it’ll randomly change some icons to random gibberish or letters for no reason. It has nothing to do with what I am asking it to do. Am I using it wrong, or is it just not good for this particular style of work? I’d like to utilize it when necessary, but I just can’t trust it to do anything. Since I have no idea what else it is messing with. For me, claude has never done some odd thing like this in my experience.

comments.author: sloth2121
comments.body:
If I had to guess. Youre changing LLM’s mid conversation which is a guaranteed degrade in code. 

That being said, it may just take a bit to get used to the new environment 

I use ChatGPT 5.4 codex 
It can be slow at things but as much as it speeds up my work flow, I feel it’s worth it
